headline: Shanti Gold International Limited: Board approval for Rights Issue to raise capital
sum: Shanti Gold International Limited's board approved a rights issue to raise funds. The company disclosed the board outcome to NSE on 30 June 2026 as per regulatory filing requirements.
detail: The NSE filing dated 30 June 2026 discloses board approval of a rights issue capital raising. Specific issue size, ratio, pricing and timeline for shareholder approval remain to be disclosed in subsequent regulatory filings. The company will need to file a detailed offer document with SEBI and obtain stock exchange approvals before the rights offer opens to shareholders.
